## Which power stations will it work with?

The SP037 is compatible with **8 of the 10 stations** in the article.

<badge color="success">Compatible</badge>

| Power station | Solar input range |
|---|---:|
| ALLPOWERS P1800 | Compatible |
| ALLPOWERS S2000 Pro | Compatible |
| ALLPOWERS R4000 | Compatible |
| BLUETTI AC180 | Compatible |
| BLUETTI AC200L | Compatible |
| BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 | Compatible |
| BLUETTI Elite 300 | Compatible |

<badge color="danger">Not compatible</badge>

| Power station | Reason |
|---|---|
| Tenergy T320 | 5–24 V input; panel Voc is 45.3 V |
| BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 | 12–28 V input; panel Voc is 45.3 V |

**My recommendation:** If you're buying this panel, pair it with the ALLPOWERS P1800 or one of the compatible BLUETTI models. Avoid the T320 and Elite 30 V2 because the panel's open-circuit voltage exceeds their solar input limits.
